## GEOGRAPHY predicates
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# The examples of ST_CONTAINS and ST_COVERS test points on the exterior, the boundary and the
# interior of a polygon; ST_WITHIN and ST_COVEREDBY are documented as those with the arguments
# swapped, and ST_DISJOINT as the negation of ST_INTERSECTS. The descriptions give the rest, with
# OGC's interiors, without a polygon's rings or a linestring's endpoints, and BigQuery's answers
# the cases they leave open.

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 10))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 10))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 10), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_COVEREDBY(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_COVEREDBY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'))
=> "true"

# A polygon's boundary is among its points, but not in its interior.
SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_DISJOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DISJOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 10))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 10))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 20 1, 10 20, 1 1))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "false"

# A hole is outside the polygon, and its ring is the polygon's boundary.
SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 10 10, 0 10, 0 0), (2 2, 8 2, 8 8, 2 8, 2 2))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(5, 5))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 10 10, 0 10, 0 0), (2 2, 8 2, 8 8, 2 8, 2 2))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 10 10, 0 10, 0 0), (2 2, 8 2, 8 8, 2 8, 2 2))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 2))
=> "true"

# Polygons.
SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 4 0, 4 4, 0 4, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 4 0, 4 4, 0 4, 0 0))'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 4 0, 4 4, 0 4, 0 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 3 1, 3 3, 1 3, 1 1))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 3 1, 3 3, 1 3, 1 1))'))
=> "false"

# Polygons that share an edge touch.
SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((2 0, 4 0, 4 2, 2 2, 2 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DISJOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((3 0, 4 0, 4 1, 3 0))'))
=> "true"

# A linestring on a polygon's boundary is covered but not contained; one that reaches the
# boundary from the interior is contained.
SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 2 2)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 2)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 3 1, 3 3, 1 3, 1 1))'))
=> "false"

# Linestrings that cross meet in their interiors; those that meet at an endpoint touch.
SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 -1, 0 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-1 0, 1 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 -1, 0 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-1 0, 1 0)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "false"

# A linestring covers its own edges, whichever way they run.
SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 0 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'))
=> "true"

# A point's interior is the point.
SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "false"

# An empty geography has no points: it neither covers nor is covered.
SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_COVEREDBY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_DISJOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> null

SELECT ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_DISJOINT(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> null

SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> null

SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_COVEREDBY(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> null

# BigQuery's answers: a vertex within a micrometer of another, or of an edge, meets it there,
# so a point between the vertices of a linestring is on it, and one on a polygon's edge is on its
# boundary.

SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 1))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1.000000000001))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(2.000000000001, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(2.000000000001, 2))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 1 1)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 1 2)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 2 1, 2 2, 1 2, 1 1))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DISJOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "true"
